extDescription.message: Bilingual web page translation with your own LLM. One click, no tracking.

baseUrlHint.message: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1, https://api.deepseek.com, https://openrouter.ai/api/v1, http://localhost:11434/v1

apiKeyHint.message: Stored only in this browser and sent only to the API base URL above. Leave empty for local servers such as Ollama.

extraBodyHint.message: Merged into every request body, e.g. {"reasoning_effort": "none"} for reasoning models.

permissionDenied.message: Access to the API host was not granted, so translations cannot be sent there.

badExtraBody.message: Extra request fields must be a JSON object.

missingConfig.message: Fill in the API base URL and model first.
